rules.label: Financial assistance per sliding scale based on Federal Poverty Guidelines
rules.quote: Financial assistance is generally determined by a sliding scale of total household income based on Federal Poverty Guidelines

notes: Policy references a sliding scale chart with categories (e.g., category Z for family of 1 making $4,500) and a responsibility chart (e.g., $1,000 bill -> $0 responsibility) but the summary does not include the actual tables.
Service exclusions exist (transplants, cosmetic services, and others) but cannot be expressed with the available vocabulary.

AGB (Amounts Generally Billed) is used as a cap: eligible patients will not be charged more than AGB for medically necessary care. AGB is calculated from all claims paid in full by Medicare and private insurers over a 12-month period divided by associated gross charges.
Patients with sufficient insurance coverage or assets may be deemed ineligible.
Application process requires form and supporting documents submitted to Business Office at 800 S 3rd Street, Montrose, CO 81401.
Policy and application available in English and Spanish; translation aids may be provided.
All Montrose Regional Health providers participate in the program.

rule_financial_assistance may leave out a condition: While being uninsured or underinsured is part of eligibility, the policy additionally requires meeting income-based sliding scale criteria tied to household income relative to FPL.

dropped.quote: No person eligible for financial assistance under the FAP will be charged more for medically necessary care than amounts generally billed to individuals who have insurance covering such care
dropped.why: The quoted text prohibits charging more than AGB for medically necessary patients' AGB; it does not establish medical necessity as a universal requirement for receiving any financial assistance.

rules.label: Financial Assistance Program general eligibility
rules.quote: You may be able to get financial assistance if you do not have insurance, are underinsured, or if it would be a financial hardship to pay in full the expected out of pocket expenses for services at Montrose Regional Health.

rules.label: Amounts Generally Billed limit
rules.quote: No person eligible for financial assistance under the FAP will be charged more for medically necessary care than amounts generally billed to individuals who have insurance covering such care (AGB).

notes: The policy mentions service exclusions not typically eligible for financial assistance, including transplants, cosmetic services and other services.
The policy references a sliding scale based on Federal Poverty Guidelines and family size but does not specify exact percentages or discount amounts in the summary provided.
Applications can be submitted online, by mail, in person at the Business Office, or by phone.
The policy is available in English and Spanish, with translation aids available upon request.
The hospital determines AGB based on claims paid by Medicare and private insurers over a 12-month period.
rule_fap_general may leave out a condition: policy requires Colorado residency and being in the hospital's service area
rule_agb_limit may leave out a condition: policy limits charges only for those already eligible for financial assistance under FAP

disagreements_before: A household of 3 earning $27,000 a year (98.8% of the poverty line), living in Colorado, insured, and not under-insured as the policy defines it, owing $10,000: the Nemotron 3 Ultra model gives no help, the Nemotron 3 Super model gives help (amount not stated).

A household of 3 earning $27,000 a year (98.8% of the poverty line), living in Colorado, uninsured, owing $10,000, after elective care: the Nemotron 3 Ultra model gives help (amount not stated), the Nemotron 3 Super model gives no help.
